title: NewAPI Smart Router effective route price
description: A versioned static price descriptor used only for routing comparisons. It must be derived from the same resolved model and group pricing contract used by reservation and settlement.

billing_mode.description: Examples include ratio, fixed_price and tiered_expr. Hosts may extend this vocabulary only with matching billing and conformance support.

billing_unit.description: Examples include per_token, per_request, per_second and fixed_duration.

fixed_duration_seconds.description: Part of price identity when a fixed-duration contract is used.

comparison_class.description: Only descriptors with the exact same class are ordered by score_ppm. The class must include every cost-shape field that changes comparability.

score_ppm.description: Resolved model base price multiplied by the effective group ratio exactly once, encoded in fixed-point PPM. It is not a user balance mutation.

synthetic.description: Synthetic evidence may participate only where explicitly supported and must never train cache-economy observations. Inherited NewAPI prices use the real global model price and are not synthetic.

scope.description: Origin of the resolved base price, such as global_model, group_model or legacy.

revision.description: Immutable pricing-contract revision frozen for the request.

incomparable_reason.description: Stable reason code when a reliable static comparison cannot be made.
